title: Diamond cooling market gains traction as AI chip heat rises
html:
Rising power demands from AI chips are drawing interest in diamond-based cooling. However, high costs, manufacturing yields, and integration challenges continue to constrain commercial adoption, according to DIGITIMES analyst Eric Lin.
